StartYear1=2028 is the MGS-3 network in-service year, not a Package-16-specific milestone (this package was carved out/retendered and awarded ~a year behind the mainline packages).
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE (high, real): P6736 = MGS-3 Package 16, 'laying a 52km pipeline to serve customers in the Jeddah area' (MEED's MGS-3 package table). Independently documented across multiple non-GEM origins: MEED (trade press, the source the sheet already cites) lists Package 16 = 52 km Jeddah line; Gulf Fire (industry news, 23 Oct 2024) 'EPC Contract Secured for 52-Kilometer Pipeline Network in Jeddah' names Tekfen Constructions & Installations as EPC; DMS Projects carries a dedicated Package 16 record (PRJ00030617, status 'On Going', purpose 'extend the Master Gas System to supply power plants in the Western Province'); also BNC Network and Tube & Pipe India. Not a GEM-derived entity. CLASSIFICATION (transmission defensible): Package 16 is one of the lateral/distribution-tier packages (12-17) rather than a 56-inch mainline, and is described as serving customers in the Jeddah area. But DMS states its purpose is to EXTEND the Master Gas System to supply Western-Province power plants, and MEED groups all 15 pipe packages as 'gas transport pipelines' - so PipelineType=transmission is defensible and consistent with the sibling lateral rows (P6732/P6733/P6735/P6737 all recorded transmission). Fuel=Gas correct. Noted as a caveat, not a concern. DUPLICATE (checked, NOT a duplicate): 52 km is unique among the 22 roster rows - the other western/lateral packages are P6735 (192 km, Yanbu-Rabigh/Makkah), P6737 (196 km, Jizan). No relabel or segment double-count. ATTRIBUTION: Owner Aramco 100% correct (Aramco's own Master Gas System). EPC = Tekfen (Gulf Fire, Oct 2024) after the package was retendered (Gulf Fire tenders-reissued article; original bid deadline 30 May 2024, and it was still unawarded in the initial MEED contractor-selection round). Endpoints are only ever given as 'the Jeddah area / Jeddah cluster' - no source states discrete start/end nodes, so StartLocation/EndLocation remain unfillable; province = Makkah staged as a fill (Jeddah lies in Makkah Province; DMS calls it 'Western Province'). SPEC: length 52 km agrees across MEED + Gulf Fire (2 independent, value present) - high. Diameter is N/A in every source including MEED's own table (the only lateral package with no diameter disclosed) - left blank, correct, NOT fabricated. Capacity not disclosed per package - left blank. StartYear1=2028 = the MGS-3 network in-service target, not a Package-16 milestone; defensible but a caveat given this package's later award. All materially checkable points corroborated at >=2 independent sources.

fills.researcher_notes: Location [ref] was blank (only StartCountryOrArea/EndCountryOrArea=Saudi Arabia populated). Both sources place the entire 52 km line 'within the Jeddah cluster / Jeddah area'; Jeddah is in Makkah Province, so province=Makkah for both ends is a well-supported fill (DMS labels it informally 'Western Province'). Discrete Start/End node names are NOT disclosed by any source, so StartLocation/EndLocation left blank rather than fabricated. Diameter and capacity also undisclosed - not filled.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Status 'construction' still defensible. Package 16 was carved out and retendered (Gulf Fire tenders-reissued; original technical-bid deadline 30 May 2024), then the EPC was awarded to Tekfen, announced by Gulf Fire on 23 Oct 2024. DMS Projects public record shows status 'On Going'. With EPC awarded and the wider MGS-3 program in active construction (sibling packages welding as of Aug 2025), 'construction' is appropriate. No evidence of commissioning/start-up (not operating) and none of shelving/cancellation. Not stale: EPC awarded <2y ago within an active program. Newest DATED Package-16-specific evidence found is the Oct-2024 EPC award; DMS 'On Going' is undated on the public page. Could not locate dated on-site progress newer than the sheet's 2025-08-07 LastUpdated for this specific package, but nothing contradicts construction.

summary: P6736 = MGS-3 Package 16 (Jeddah-area 52 km line): existence/classification/duplicate/attribution/spec all confirmed vs MEED + Gulf Fire (52 km agrees; diameter genuinely undisclosed; Tekfen EPC, Aramco owner); verdict confirmed (caveat) - customer-serving lateral classed transmission (defensible) and StartYear1=2028 is network in-service year. Status=construction confirmed (EPC awarded ~Oct 2024, DMS 'On Going'). Filled province=Makkah.
